title: Canonical structural-unit factor-order cohomology transport
statement: For schemes X, S, T and maps f:X→S and g:T→S [def-pc-scheme], define the additive isomorphism on degree-one cohomology by normalizing tensor pullbacks of the structural unit [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], applying contravariant structural cohomology to inverse pullback symmetry [lem-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap-functorial], and undoing normalization. This explicitly constructed isomorphism is linear over Γ(T,O_T), with the source action through the first projection and the target action through the second projection. The construction requires no affine or properness assumption.

proof.text: Normalize the coefficient using the actual adjoint structural-unit isomorphism. Contravariant functoriality and the identity formula give the isomorphism induced by inverse pullback symmetry. Undo normalization. Cohomology coefficient morphisms are linear and cohomology pullback is semilinear; the pullback projection equation identifies the two scalar actions.
